answer: Confirmed work escrow makes an identity's scarce resource independently verified task completions rather than capital. Each new identity must finish jobs whose credits stay locked in an umber ledger until distinct downstream agents confirm delivery and accept liability; false confirmations forfeit those credits. A fable of instant reputation cannot bypass this because credits do not transfer between identities. An attacker must complete real timber-sourcing work for every puppet, wait through confirmation delays, and risk locked credits if collusion is detected.
